tests_executed.details: Modal layout verified to fit in viewport. Internal scrolling is functional. Checkboxes and fields are clickable. Upon saving attendance, reopening the session correctly restores the previously saved attendance records without duplicating.
Modal layout confirmed. Validated that ONLY active backlog students appear for the chosen subject. Attendance persists securely.
Verified the Attendance/Progress view pulls aggregated totals for Guest Lectures and Remedial Classes. Session history correctly updates upon resubmission.

Guest Lecture explicitly filters its target audience by Branch and Year via `guestLecture.controller.js -> getTargetStudents`, independent of backlog status. Students without active backlogs correctly appear in the Attendance/Progress dashboard if they attended a Guest Lecture.
The backend utilizes `upsert: true` combined with an immutable `attendanceSessionId` and `studentId` index. Re-submitting attendance guarantees zero duplicate records in the database.
The 'No student attendance records found' message correctly handles unpopulated progress records, appearing only when zero sessions exist.
Rich PDF exports pull directly from the committed `AttendanceRecord` database entries, not the transient client state.

cleanup_result.details: Deleted all temporary 'UAT Final GL' and 'UAT Final RC' records and their associated AttendanceSessions and AttendanceRecords. Original production data and the Coordinator account remain intact.

build_test_result: SUCCESS - All TypeScript errors resolved and `npm run build` completed successfully.
